description: Animation tables of the story characters in the cutscenes of map5_s02 (Annie's Bar and Indian Runner (Resort Area)). A cutscene asks whether a character's animation is done ("playback") and which keyframe it starts at ("start_keyframe"; the same tables as playback when absent); the answer comes from the table named here, a file gamedata/tables/anim/<table>.json indexed by the character's animation status. "tables" maps a character name to its table and "fallback" is the table of every character not listed (none: such a character has no table). On this map, playback: every character uses "kaufmann". Start keyframe: no character has a table. The first-keyframe query has no table for any character (the original read through a null table). "cue_sounds" sets the volume (0..255) of sounds (names of gamedata/sounds) that an animation keyframe cues: kaufmann_shot at 255 (heard at full volume at any distance); kaufmann_cue at 128; any other cued sound plays at 128. Read when the map loads.
